name: Standing Order Total Amount 1
definition: Provides details on the overall amount of "not yet executed" predefined liquidity transfer orders or "defined" by a system participant in its sphere of responsibility within the system.

SetPredefinedOrder.name: Set Predefined Order
SetPredefinedOrder.definition: Total defined amount of predefined liquidity transfer orders.

PendingPredefinedOrder.name: Pending Predefined Order
PendingPredefinedOrder.definition: Total amount of not yet executed predefined liquidity transfer orders.

SetStandingOrder.name: Set Standing Order
SetStandingOrder.definition: Total defined amount of standing liquidity transfer orders.

PendingStandingOrder.name: Pending Standing Order
PendingStandingOrder.definition: Total amount of not yet executed standing liquidity transfer orders.
